title: Diagonal Frog meets ADI: trading matrix exponentials for rational maps in the Fokker--Planck equation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22703v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A companion paper \cite{ItkinDF2026} introduced the Diagonal Frog (DF) positivity-preserving schemes for anisotropic Fokker--Planck equations, advancing each directional substep by a Krylov-computed matrix exponential, which dominates the cost. Replacing that exponential by a rational map $r(\gamma L)$ reduces the substep to a banded solve, but the positivity argument no longer applies. We prove that for eventually exponentially positive generators the entrywise sign of $r(\gamma L)$ at large steps is decided by a single number, the value $r(\infty)$ taken on infinitely stiff modes. Nonnegativity holds above a computable threshold when $0\le r(\infty)<1$, and at most on a bounded interval, empty or vanishingly narrow in all our tests, when $r(\infty)<0$. The criterion rejects the Crank--Nicolson (trapezoidal) method, where $r(\infty)=-1$, and selects the subdiagonal Pad\'e$(0,2)$ method, which is second order, L-stable and provably pos

translated_title: 对角蛙与ADI相遇：在福克-普朗克方程中用有理映射交换矩阵指数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22703v1 公告类型：交叉  摘要：一篇配套论文 \cite{ItkinDF2026} 介绍了用于各向异性福克-普朗克方程的对角蛙（DF）保正性格式，通过Krylov计算的矩阵指数推进每个方向子步，这主导了计算成本。将该指数替换为有理映射 $r(\gamma L)$ 将子步简化为带状求解，但正性论证不再适用。我们证明，对于最终指数正生成的算子，大步长下 $r(\gamma L)$ 的逐元素符号由单个数字决定，即无穷刚硬模式上的值 $r(\infty)$。当 $0\le r(\infty)<1$ 时，非负性在可计算的阈值以上成立；当 $r(\infty)<0$ 时，最多在一个有界区间内成立，该区间在所有测试中为空或极窄。该准则拒绝了Crank--Nicolson（梯形）方法，其中 $r(\infty)=-1$，并选择了次对角Padé$(0,2)$ 方法，该方法为二阶、L-稳定且可证明正性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于有理映射替换矩阵指数的方法，通过分析无穷刚硬模式值 $r(\infty)$ 来保证福克-普朗克方程求解的正性，并选择次对角Padé$(0,2)$ 方法作为有效且保正的选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes replacing matrix exponentials with rational maps to ensure positivity in Fokker-Planck equation solvers, using the infinite-stiffness value $r(\infty)$ as a criterion, and selects the subdiagonal Padé(0,2) method as effective and positivity-preserving.
